title: Convergence handoff: weekly cross-pillar agenda & action capture
content:
Purpose: quick, pragmatic cross-pillar sync to surface risky rollouts, API/console blockers, and short-cycle action items. This is my personal prep doc — noisy, TODOs, and items I want to call out in the 30m meeting.

Attendees (invite): Diego (Infra), Ibrahim (Runtime), Hannah (Console), Marta (host), optional: SRE on-call, Solutions Eng rep
Timebox: 30 minutes (5m checkins, 20m focused topics, 5m action + followups)
Frequency: weekly, Wed 10:00 PT

TOPLINE CONTEXT (one-liners):
- Production tail latency spike during canary (Tue night) — probably due to model shard placement + transient OOM on p4d. See INF-842 for traces.
- Console rollout (feature flags UI) blocked by API perf regression after PR 512 — Hannah investigating exact RPCs.
- Autoscaler tuning patch staged; need cross-validate in staging with real workload (burst profile).

AGENDA (prep notes / owner):
1) Quick signals & triage (5m) — who: Diego
   - Key metrics to call: p99 token latency, server OOM rate, request backlog depth (queue length) — grab last 6 hours.
   - Quick ask: confirm if on-call escalation happened overnight (yes/no).
   - My note: if no escalation, push to SRE to review page alerts thresholds. TODO: ping SRE #ops-oncall before meeting.

2) Canary incident recap & immediate mitigations (8m) — who: Ibrahim + Diego
   - Summary: failing canary for small subset of shards during long prompt sequences. Trace points to KV-cache thrash when sequence > 8k.
   - Hypotheses: kernel selection path picks float16 variant causing extra memory copies; autoscaler scales up too slowly.
   - Short-term mitigation options: reduce canary traffic, pin model variant with conservative kernel selection, bump pod memory limit.
   - Action at meeting: pick one mitigation now (aim: reduce user impact within 60m).

3) Console / API regression blocking UI rollout (7m) — who: Hannah
   - Problem: API latency increase from PR512 when requesting model metadata (bulk metadata endpoints).
   - Workarounds: cache metadata in client for 30s; add secondary fast path in console to avoid blocking.
   - Decision needed: delay rollout by 24–48h or proceed with feature-flagged rollout?

4) Autoscaler and staging test plan (5m) — who: Diego + Marta
   - Test plan checklist: realistic burst profile (from production workload sample), 30m run with KV-cache warmups, observe cold-start p95.
   - Requirement: coordinate with Solutions Eng to replay workload. Link to replay job: INF-842 job-7.

5) Actions, owners, and followups (5m) — who: Marta (capture)

MEETING NOTES TEMPLATE (what I'll capture live):
- Decision summary (1–2 lines)
- Actions with owner + due date
- Tickets created / updated
- Blocking items for next sync

MY PRE-FLIGHT TODOs (before Wed 10):
- pull last 6h p99/p95/token throughputs from observability (Metrics dashboard -> serving-pipeline) — Marta (done? not yet)
- ping SRE on-call to be present if escalation repeats — Marta (slack ping queued)
- attach trace links for INF-842 into meeting notes — Marta
- add short URL to PR512 and annotate suspected hot RPC (get Hannah to point to RPC name)

ACTION ITEM CANDIDATES (raw scratch list — convert to formal items at meeting):
- Diego: increase mmap/oom guard on canary nodes, roll a conservative kernel profile to canary group. Due: today EOD. Linked ticket: INF-842.
- Ibrahim: instrument KV-cache eviction stats for long prompts; add a metric for eviction_rate_10m. Due: +2 days.
- Hannah: decouple metadata bulk RPC in console behind a fast-path and feature flag. Draft PR: raise by EOD. Decision: if not ready, gate rollout.
- Marta: coordinate staging replay window and approve autoscaler test (block schedule window: Thu 02:00–04:00 PT). Create schedule ticket and share with Solutions Eng.
- SRE: validate alert thresholds (queue_depth > 200 and p99 > 2s) and confirm runbook.

NOTES TO SELF / RISK FLAGS:
- If we do quick pin to conservative kernel, verify that latency regresses less than 10% for common prompts; otherwise users will see slowdown. Need quick perf sanity run (5–10 mins).
- Risk of cascading restarts if memory limit bumped without proper pod disruption budget tuning — include release-engineering in change window.
- Console change may hide underlying perf problem; prefer to fix API but may need temporary UI guardrail.

QUICK LINKS / REFERENCES:
- INF-842 (incident & traces): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-842
- PR512 (suspect): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/512
- Staging replay job: https://replay.internal.redwood.ai/jobs/8823
- Slack thread: #serving-incidents C12345 (pin message)

OPEN QUESTIONS (to raise):
- Can Solutions Eng provide a deterministic sample workload that includes >10k token long prompts? (Ibrahim to confirm)
- Is there an easy way to feature-flag kernel selection? (Diego + Runtime research)
- Do we have a quick dashboard tile to show eviction_rate_10m? If not, add as dashboard request.

POST-MEETING FOLLOWUPS (what I'll do after):
- update INF-842 with decision + attach demo traces (Marta)
- convert candidate actions into GitHub issues (small ones) and tag owners (Marta)
- schedule 15m rapid check tomorrow if mitigation applied (all)

STYLE/VOICE NOTES: keep this doc lightweight, not polished. I'm intentionally writing fragments so I can triage fast in the meeting. Move final action list into a proper doc once decisions locked.

END.
